unregister_clear_reachability.claim: The selected static platform-driver unregister/remove dispatch cannot reach HifAhbPltmRemove or its call to mtk_wcn_wmt_wlan_unreg, independently of whether exitWlan is invoked.
unregister_clear_reachability.conditions: The nested generic driver remove member starts zero. __platform_driver_register installs platform_drv_remove only when the platform remove is nonnull; it is NULL here. The platform bus initializer has no remove member. The detach path tries a bus remove first, otherwise a generic driver remove, so neither selected slot dispatches to the AHB callback-clear body. This excludes only this static remove dispatch, with no unproved pointer mutation; it is not a runtime observation or a global claim that callbacks can never be cleared elsewhere.

unregister_clear_reachability.next_discriminator: Keep static dispatch reachability=false separate from runtime invocation=null. Any later invocation or synchronization proposal needs its own caller/state proof.
